diagnosis: The telehealth clinical notes endpoint executes a MongoDB findAndModify operation using only the consultation _id criteria without checking attending physician assignment. Any registered physician in the hospital network can tamper with diagnosis summaries and drug prescription references for patients under the care of other specialists.
